## Pull request overview

Implements a package-level metadata publishing workflow across the spec contract, metadata runtime manager, and runtime HTTP surface so dependent metadata can be published/reverted atomically and consumers can fetch the last published snapshot.

**Changes:**
- Extend the spec metadata persistence model with `publishedDefinition/publishedAt/publishedBy` and add `PackagePublishResult` + new `IMetadataService` contract methods.
- Add `publishPackage()`, `revertPackage()`, and `getPublished()` to `MetadataManager` with validation + snapshotting behavior, plus corresponding tests.
- Expose publish/revert and getPublished behaviors through runtime HTTP dispatching and update docs/roadmap.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.zod.ts | Adds published snapshot fields to `MetadataRecordSchema` and introduces `PackagePublishResultSchema`. |
| packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.test.ts | Adds tests for new publishing fields and publish result schema validation. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts | Extends `IMetadataService` with optional package publish/revert/getPublished methods. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.test.ts | Updates contract tests to include the new optional methods. |
| packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts | Implements `publishPackage`, `revertPackage`, and `getPublished` in the runtime metadata manager. |
| packages/metadata/src/metadata-service.test.ts | Adds unit + integration-style tests for package publish/revert/getPublished behavior. |
| packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts | Adds HTTP dispatch support for publish/revert and `.../published` retrieval. |
| packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts | Adds tests for the new dispatcher endpoints and broker fallbacks. |
| packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts | Registers new package publish/revert HTTP routes in the dispatcher plugin. |
| packages/metadata/README.md | Documents the new package publishing APIs. |
| content/docs/guides/contracts/metadata-service.mdx | Adds documentation for publish/revert/getPublished and REST endpoints. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks package-level metadata publishing as completed and references follow-up work. |
</details>

`publishPackage()` accepts `changeNote` in options but never uses or persists it. If it’s intentionally not supported yet, consider removing it from the options (or explicitly documenting it as not implemented); otherwise persist it as part of the publish audit trail so callers don’t assume it’s recorded.

The docs list REST endpoints under `/metadata/...`, but the runtime/adapters in this repo expose metadata routes under `/meta` (e.g. `/api/v1/meta/...`). To avoid sending users to non-existent endpoints, update these paths to the actual `/meta/:type/:name/published` route (and keep it consistent with the rest of the docs).
```suggestion
| `GET` | `/meta/:type/:name/published` | Get published version of a metadata item |
```

`handlePackages()` currently requires an ObjectQL `registry` to be present before it will route any requests. That means the new `/packages/:id/publish` and `/packages/:id/revert` endpoints won’t work when the ObjectQL service/registry is unavailable (even if the metadata service is available), because the handler returns early to `handlePackagesViaBroker()` which doesn’t implement publish/revert. Consider handling publish/revert before the `registry` availability check, or adding publish/revert support to the broker fallback path.

In the broker fallback for `GET /meta/:type/:name/published`, the result is always returned as 200 even if the broker returns `undefined`. The metadata-service path treats `undefined` as not found (404), so the broker fallback should mirror that behavior (check for `undefined` and return 404) to keep the endpoint semantics consistent.

The code uses the existing `version` field to represent the package publish version (`newVersion`) and overwrites it for every item. In this codebase, `MetadataRecord.version` is already used for optimistic concurrency / update counting (e.g. DatabaseLoader increments it on each save). Mixing these semantics will make publish versions drift with edits and can break concurrency expectations. Consider introducing a dedicated publish/version field (e.g. `publishedVersion`/`packageVersion`) and keep `version` for concurrency, or compute publish version from a separate stored counter.

`publishedDefinition` is set via `structuredClone(item.data.metadata ?? item.data)`. If an item is missing the `metadata` payload envelope, this snapshots the entire record object (including audit fields / previously publishedDefinition), and `revertPackage()` later writes that back into `metadata`, corrupting the stored shape. It would be safer to snapshot only `item.data.metadata` (and treat missing `metadata` as a validation error) so `publishedDefinition` consistently represents the published definition payload.
